mapper.select: SELECT x.turn_id,x.thread_id,x.state,x.provider_id,x.model_id,x.provider,x.api,x.upstream_model, x.reasoning_level,x.access_mode,x.config_generation,x.mutation_version,x.requested_at,x.updated_at, x.completed_at,x.terminal_summary,x.error_code,x.error_message,x.cancel_requested_at,x.cancel_reason, x.cancel_expected_thread_revision,x.cancel_thread_revision,x.cancel_turn_mutation_version, NULL AS thread_revision,c.change_set_json FROM turns x LEFT JOIN turn_change_sets c ON c.turn_id=x.turn_id WHERE x.thread_id=#{threadId} AND x.turn_id=#{turnId}

SELECT x.turn_id,x.thread_id,x.state,x.provider_id,x.model_id,x.provider,x.api,x.upstream_model, x.reasoning_level,x.access_mode,x.config_generation,x.mutation_version,x.requested_at,x.updated_at, x.completed_at,x.terminal_summary,x.error_code,x.error_message,x.cancel_requested_at,x.cancel_reason, x.cancel_expected_thread_revision,x.cancel_thread_revision,x.cancel_turn_mutation_version, NULL AS thread_revision,c.change_set_json FROM turns x LEFT JOIN turn_change_sets c ON c.turn_id=x.turn_id WHERE x.thread_id=#{threadId} ORDER BY x.requested_at,x.turn_id

SELECT x.turn_id,x.thread_id,x.state,x.provider_id,x.model_id,x.provider,x.api,x.upstream_model, x.reasoning_level,x.access_mode,x.config_generation,x.mutation_version,x.requested_at,x.updated_at, x.completed_at,x.terminal_summary,x.error_code,x.error_message,x.cancel_requested_at,x.cancel_reason, x.cancel_expected_thread_revision,x.cancel_thread_revision,x.cancel_turn_mutation_version, t.revision AS thread_revision,c.change_set_json FROM turns x JOIN threads t ON t.thread_id=x.thread_id LEFT JOIN turn_change_sets c ON c.turn_id=x.turn_id WHERE x.turn_id=#{turnId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(ordinal)+1,1) FROM messages WHERE thread_id=#{threadId}
SELECT message_id,turn_id,ordinal,role,blocks_json,created_at FROM messages WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} ORDER BY ordinal
SELECT call_id,state,revision,ordinal,tool_name,side_effect FROM tools WHERE turn_id=#{turnId} AND call_id=#{callId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tools SET state='RUNNING',revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE turn_id=#{turnId} AND call_id=#{callId} AND state='PREPARED'

UPDATE tools SET state=#{state},presentation_json=#{presentationJson},artifact_id=#{artifactId},revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE turn_id=#{turnId} AND call_id=#{callId} AND state IN ('PREPARED','RUNNING')
UPDATE tools SET presentation_json=#{presentationJson},revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE turn_id=#{turnId} AND call_id=#{callId} AND state IN ('PREPARED','RUNNING')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tools WHERE turn_id=#{turnId} AND state IN ('PREPARED','RUNNING')
mapper.update: UPDATE tools SET state=#{state}, presentation_json=json_set(presentation_json,'$.status',#{presentationStatus}, '$.outputPreview',#{outputPreview}), revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE turn_id=#{turnId} AND state IN ('PREPARED','RUNNING')
mapper.select: SELECT artifact_id,content,character_length FROM tool_artifacts WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND turn_id=#{turnId} AND call_id=#{callId} AND artifact_id=#{artifactId}
SELECT approval_id,decision,expires_at FROM approvals WHERE turn_id=#{turnId} AND approval_id=#{approvalId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM usage WHERE turn_id=#{turnId}
SELECT input_id,thread_id,turn_id,kind,text,created_at FROM pending_inputs WHERE turn_id=#{turnId} AND kind=#{kind} AND state='PENDING' ORDER BY created_at,input_id LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE pending_inputs SET state='CONSUMED',consumed_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE input_id=#{inputId} AND state='PENDING'
UPDATE pending_inputs SET state='CANCELLED',consumed_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE turn_id=#{turnId} AND state='PENDING'
